metadata.algorithm: Positive-weight CMA-ES with increasing-population restarts at the previous final mean
metadata.seed_policy: CMA seed = restart index; restart mean = previous run final recombined mean
metadata.stopping: Function spread <1e-8 over current population and 10+ceil(60/q) recent generation bests, search scale <1e-7, or 220-generation teaching cap; stop overall at target 1e-8 or budget.
